prompt: Which invasive species was first introduced to Taal Lake and in what year?
response: The first invasive (alien) species reported in Taal Lake were the jaguar fish, pangasius, and black‑chinned tilapia, whose presence began to increase markedly in 2009 (Mutia, Muyot, Torres Jr., & Faminialagao, 2018).<INLINE_CITATION>(Mutia et al., 2018)</INLINE_CITATION>
